why: Controlled conditional experiment, not a measured real-world frequency: world=scene, one bicycle hazard per simulated scene (exposure=1); no per-trip rate is inferred. Bicycle starts in the outer lane and crosses about one 3.5 m lane width (3.1–3.5 m) over 2.4–2.8 s; maximum cosine lateral acceleration is pi^2*3.5/(2*2.4^2)=2.999 m/s^2, within avsim.studio.BIKE_LAT_MAX=3.0. x=45–55 m is a +/-5 m sensitivity neighbourhood around the constructed x=50 m scene; trigger 8–14 m tests late swerves while retaining physical feasibility. Uniform ranges are declared experimental design choices, not fitted distributions or claims about road traffic.
